_about: SABOTAGE (anchorStep folds '+'): the QUEUE anchored this task to NZTEST-4500X-16SFP and the page it fetched is about NZTEST-4500X-16SFP+ — a different catalogue row, a different line card. Until 4 Sep 2026 anchorStep normalised '+' away, called it the Cisco spare form, and short-circuited the resolver: the '+' card's PoE budget was written onto the plain card without one lookup ever running. The anchor must decline, and the resolver must land this on the '+' part by its own exact step.
